This week is your home turf under a different name, so the only new content is the finance-specific machinery and the fact that in this field the number of tests is almost never reported.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- State the correspondence between a genome-wide scan and a backtest search, term by term, including what plays the role of linkage disequilibrium between tests.
- Say why a Bonferroni correction is the wrong instrument here even though the logic is right.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>55 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [35 min]{.task-min} Read Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado and Zhu on pseudo-mathematics and financial charlatanism, in full. It is short, polemical and correct, and it is the clearest statement of the problem that exists.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Write the correspondence table in reports/milestone-02-noise-floor.md: variant tried against variant tested, effect size against Sharpe ratio, discovery threshold against required Sharpe, correlated tests against correlated strategy variants, winner's curse against the inflation of the best backtest, replication against out-of-sample. One row each, and one row for what has no analogue.
:::
